name: Instagram carousel images and caption with FLUX 2 (MegaBrain)

parameters.content:
# Instagram carousel — FLUX 2
Give a topic. A free text model plans the slides and writes the caption, **FLUX 2** draws every slide in 4:5, and the last node returns the image URLs plus the caption, ready for Instagram, Blotato or Drive.

FLUX 2 costs $0.014 per megapixel: a 5-slide carousel is about $0.14.

## Setup (2 minutes)
1. Get a key at [getmegabrain.com/keys](https://getmegabrain.com/keys).
2. In n8n create a **Header Auth** credential named `MegaBrain API key`:
   - Name: `Authorization`
   - Value: `Bearer YOUR_KEY`
3. Pick it in every HTTP Request node with the 🔑 mark.

Failed jobs are refunded automatically. Prices: [getmegabrain.com/docs/media](https://getmegabrain.com/docs/media).

assignments.name: style
assignments.value: soft pastel editorial photography, natural light, lots of empty space for text
